Forge Hybrid Coach

Here to help.

Forge is an early TestFlight beta made by Ashley Barton in the United Kingdom. Features may change and you may encounter issues while testing.

Contact

Email barton.at@gmail.com for help or to report an issue. Include your app version, what you expected and what happened. Please don’t send passwords, API keys or sensitive health details.

Beta updates

Open TestFlight on your iPhone to check for Forge updates. You can also send feedback through TestFlight. View the beta invitation; availability depends on Apple’s review and tester access.

Your account and data

To export your data, open More › Backup & import in Forge. To delete your cloud account and the data stored with it, open More › Account › Delete account. To clear this phone’s local copy, use More › Reset all data.

If you cannot access the app, email barton.at@gmail.com to request account deletion. We may need to verify that the account belongs to you.

Privacy and AI coaching

Read our privacy policy for details about Google and Apple sign-in, cloud sync, Apple Health and the AI coach. Review generated workouts before using them; Forge is a training tool and does not provide medical advice.
